'''Amanaman''' was the nickname of an [[Amani/Legends|Amani]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] criminal, [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]], and headhunter from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Maridun/Legends|Maridun]]. He kept the skulls of the fugitives he scoured [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] for and used them to decorate his staff, earning the moniker '''Head Hunter''' for his collection. Amanaman spent time lurking at the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure's]] [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|palace]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Era of Rebellion]]. Amanaman was present in Jabba's palace in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], when the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] delivered a [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] message of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] asking for the release of his friend [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]. 

Later, Amanaman attended a performance of Jabba's [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] dancer, [[Oola/Legends|Oola]], and the [[Max Rebo Band/Legends|Max Rebo Band]]. After Oola was fed to [[Jabba's rancor/Legends|Jabba's rancor]], [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] arrived at the palace disguised as the bounty hunter [[Boushh/Legends|Boushh]] and negotiated with Jabba over the price of the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]]. During the talk, she pulled out a [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonator]] but deactivated it when she and the crime lord met on the price of thirty-five thousand. The morning after, Amanaman was present in the palace when Skywalker, Solo, and Chewbacca were brought to their [[Death/Legends|death]] sentencing.

==Biography==
===Palace planarian===
[[File:LaughingHermi-ROTJ.png|thumb|right|350px|Amanaman laughed when Jabba declined the offer of the droids.]]
Amanaman,<ref name="DB" /> whose true [[Amani/Legends|Amanin]] name<ref name="WWIJP" /> was unknown on the<ref name="CCG">{{CCG|set=Jabba's Palace Limited|cardname=Amanaman}}</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Complete Locations">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref> [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]],<ref name="CCG" /> was the nickname of an Amani [[Gender/Legends|male]] criminal,<ref name="DB" /> [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]], and headhunter from the grasslands of<ref name="H2H" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] planet<ref name="Maridun">{{DB|location|maridun|Maridun}}</ref> [[Maridun/Legends|Maridun]].<ref name="DB" /> He scoured [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] to hunt down fugitives and kept their skulls to use them to decorate his<ref name="Hasbro" /> Headhunter Staff,<ref name="ActionFigureArchive" /> amassing a gruesome collection. For this, Amanaman was known as the Head Hunter. The Amani was also a little-seen member of the<ref name="DB" /> [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]]<ref name="Jabba">{{FactFile|38|JAB 1-4|Jabba the Hutt}}</ref> [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure's]] [[Jabba's criminal empire/Legends|court]],<ref name="DB" /> lurking in his [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|palace]]<ref name="Action">''[[Star Wars: The Ultimate Action Figure Collection]]''</ref> on Tatooine<ref name="Complete Locations" /> during the [[Era of Rebellion/Legends|Era of Rebellion]].<ref name="Galactic Files" />

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of {{Film|VI}} to [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].</ref> Amanaman was present in<ref name="ROTJ" /> Jabba's throne room<ref name="Complete Locations" /> in his palace when two droids, [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] arrived to display a [[Hologram/Legends|holographic]] message of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], bargaining for the release of the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]. Amanaman stood near two [[Human/Legends|Humans]],<ref name="ROTJ">{{Film|VI}}</ref> proudly displayed his staff,<ref name="Archive">''[[Star Wars: The Action Figure Archive]]''</ref> and laughed when the Hutt declined and referred to the smuggler as his "favorite decoration."<ref name="ROTJ" />

===Rebel arrivals===
[[File:Geezum-Oola-ROTJ.png|thumb|left|300px|Amanaman watched Oola's dance.]]
Shortly after, Amanaman reclined in a booth with the<ref name="ROTJ" /> [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] [[Accountant/Legends|accountant]] [[Tessek/Legends|Tessek]]<ref name="Tessek">{{DB|character|tessek|Tessek}}</ref> and the [[Snivvian/Legends|Snivvian]] [[Scout/Legends|scout]] [[Geezum/Legends|Geezum]]<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|329|Geezum}}</ref> while the [[Max Rebo Band/Legends|Max Rebo Band]] performed.<ref name="ROTJ" /> Jabba demanded that his dancer, [[Oola/Legends|Oola]], repeat her performance. [[Joh Yowza/Legends|Joh Yowza]], a singer for the Max Rebo Band, thought Jabba was demanding him to preform again and the band kicked in. When Oola was dropped into the [[Rancor/Legends|rancor]] pit below for refusing to sit with Jabba,<ref name="JN">[[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi (junior novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'' junior novelization]]</ref> Amanaman stayed sat in the booth<ref name="ROTJ" /> while others rushed to see into the pit. 

Just moments after, the sound of blaster fire came through the throne room stairway.<ref name="JN" /> [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] came down the stairway disguised<ref name="ROTJ" /> as the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boushh/Legends|Boushh]],<ref name="JN" /> with the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] in tow. Both were allies of Skywalker and Solo. Jabba and the Princess negotiated the price of Chewbacca before the Hutt flew into a rage. Organa then pulled out a [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonator]] and activated it, causing almost everyone in the throne room to dive into protective cover. Jabba offered a price of thirty-five thousand for the Wookiee and the Princess deactivated the detonator. The throne room party resumed, and Chewbacca was taken down to the palace dungeons.<ref name="ROTJ" />

When night fell, Organa made her way through the throne room and unfroze Solo from the [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]] he was kept in.<ref name="ROTJ" /> Jabba and others in his organization stayed in his<ref name="JN" /> private elevator,<ref name="Complete Locations">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref> kept out of sight behind a curtain.<ref name="ROTJ" /> Opposite the elevator,<ref name="Complete Locations" /> Amanaman and others were packed<ref name="ROTJ" /> in the stairway that led to the palace's guest quarters,<ref name="JN" /> also kept behind a curtain. After Jabba laughed at the two, both curtains were pulled back, revealing Amanaman, Jabba, and the others. Solo was quickly taken to the dungeons, and Organa was escorted to Jabba.<ref name="ROTJ" />

[[File:Amanaman-Prisoners-ROTJ.png|thumb|right|350px|Jabba's prisoners were moved past Amanaman.]]
The next morning,<ref name="JN" /> Luke Skywalker arrived at the palace to free his friends, making an attempt on Jabba's life and [[Death/Legends|killing]] the crime lord's rancor while doing so. Amanaman was stood next to the<ref name="ROTJ" />  [[Chevin/Legends|Chevin]] [[Ephant Mon/Legends|Ephant Mon]]<ref name="Ephant Mon">{{DB|character|ephantmon|Mon, Ephant}}</ref> in the throne room as guards moved Skywalker, Solo, and Chewbacca past them. The three Rebels were sentenced to execution by being fed to the [[Sarlacc/Legends|sarlacc]] that lay in the [[Great Pit of Carkoon/Legends|Great Pit of Carkoon]]. During the planned execution, the Rebels were able to [[Battle of the Great Pit of Carkoon|fight back]] and kill Jabba.<ref name="ROTJ" /> 

==Personality and traits==
The giant<ref name="ActionFigureArchive">''[[Star Wars: The Action Figure Archive]]''</ref> and strange<ref name"UltimateAFA">''[[Star Wars: The Ultimate Action Figure Collection]]''</ref> Amanaman stood at 1.88 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] and weighed 85 [[Kilogram/Legends|kilograms]].<ref name="H2H" /> The planarian-like individual<ref name="Galactic Files" /> had long<ref name="Guide">''[[A Guide to the Star Wars Universe, Second Edition, Revised and Expanded]]''</ref> gangly<ref name="Galactic Files" /> [[Limb/Legends|arms]]<ref name="Guide" /> like sticks<ref name="WWIJP">{{InsiderCite|60|Who's Who in Jabba's Palace}}</ref> and big hands<ref name="Guide" /> like clubs.<ref name="WWIJP" /> It<ref name="Hasbro" /> had [[Color/Legends|red]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]]<ref name="DB" /> and yellow skin with a green back and stripe pattern.<ref name="Galactic Files" />

==Skills and abilities==
Amanaman used a rolling attack when fighting.<ref name="H2H" /> The Amani had above-average strength, intelligence, and fighting ability, below average speed, and low diplomacy skills. He was not [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]].<ref name="Galactic Files" />

==Equipment==
From around 4 ABY,<ref name="Galactic Files" /> Amanaman carried a Headhunter Staff,<ref name="ActionFigureArchive" /> used as a weapon,<ref name="DB" /> that hung the<ref name="CCG" /> three<ref name="Guide" /> prized<ref name="Galactic Files" /> shrunken heads<ref name="WWIJP" /> of his<ref name="CCG" /> unidentified<ref name="Galactic Files" /> victims.<ref name="CCG" /> He also kept a dried decapitated corpse at his side, also from an unidentified victim.<ref name="Galactic Files" /> Other weapons used by Amanaman included a [[Grenade/Legends|grenade]], a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]], and a [[Spear/Legends|spear]].<ref name="H2H" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Amanaman.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Amanaman was created for ''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']]
Amanaman was created for the [[original trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']],<ref name="Chronicles">''[[Star Wars Chronicles]]''</ref> which released on [[May 25]], [[1983]].<ref name="Year">''[[Star Wars Year by Year: A Visual Chronicle]]''</ref>  A concept maquette for the character and his staff was made, measuring 43 centimeters by 20 centimeters by 64 centimeters.<ref name="Chronicles" /> The Amanaman puppet, created by the [[Industrial Light & Magic]] creature shop,<ref name="Chronicles" /> featured to flaps at the front of the costume for ventilation.<ref name="Archeology">{{YouTube|video=RWw8-s_a0vM|text=Star Wars: Return of the Jedi - Cantina Archeology Part 3: Behind The Scenes of Jabba's Palace|channel=@CredibleNerds|name=The Credible Nerds}}</ref> The front could also be folded down to reveal the puppeteer inside.<ref name="ClassicCreatures">''[[Classic Creatures: Return of the Jedi]]''</ref> During the filming of the throne room scenes, which lasted between [[January 25]] and [[February 8]], [[1982]] at [[Elstree Studios]],<ref name="MakingOf">''[[The Making of Return of the Jedi]]''</ref> the character was portrayed by<ref name="Berk">{{OfficialSite|url=http://ailsaberk.co.uk/website/GALLERY.html|text=Ailsa Berk's official website|author=[[Ailsa Berk|Berk, Ailsa]]|archivedate=20190906022637}}</ref> mime artist<ref name="ROTJ" /> [[Ailsa Berk]].<ref name="Berk" /> Production crew used the name Amanaman,<ref name="BTM">''[[Star Wars: Behind the Magic]]''</ref> but also the nickname "Banana Slug."<ref name="Archeology" /> On [[May 12]], 1983,<ref name="Amazon UK-Paperback">{{Amazon|domain=co.uk|url=Return-Jedi-Storybook-Publisher-Publications/dp/B00SLU9N04|text=Return of the Jedi: Storybook: Written by Joan D. Vinge, 1983 Edition, Publisher: Futura Publications (Paperback)}}</ref> the character made its first appearance in an illustration in the [[Joan D. Vinge]] written ''[[Return of the Jedi: The Storybook Based on the Movie]]''.<ref name="Storybook">''[[Return of the Jedi: The Storybook Based on the Movie]]''</ref>

Amanaman appears in "[[The Emperor's Court]]", a [[Canon|non-canonical]] story by [[Jason Hall]] published in ''[[Star Wars Tales 14]]''<ref name="EmperorsCourt" /> on [[December 11]], [[2002]].<ref name="DarkHorse">{{DarkHorse|url=Comics/11-901/Star-Wars-Tales-14-Photo-Cover|text=Star Wars Tales 14}}</ref> He is present for a court case between the defendant Han Solo and the plaintiff [[Neela]] that is filmed for the [[IBC]] show "[[The Emperor's Court]]".<ref name="EmperorsCourt">{{Tales|14|The Emperor's Court}}</ref>
